meta.scope: Phase 2b increment 1 - WASH-BLANK (OP_100102) and WASH-TPCV only. Oven, gage, unload, cabinets and the CVOR inspection model are deferred to later increments.
meta.note: Statuses are self-assessed against PHOTO-01 (WASH-BLANK, full-resolution review) and PHOTO-06 (WASH-TPCV, contact-sheet review only, so medium confidence), except WC-14 which is external human evidence. No dimension is MEASURED - no controlled drawings exist (NV-011); line placement of both washers is ASSUMED and forms a continuous conveyor into the Phase 2a induction feed conveyor (belt top 1.025 m matched to IND-C-BELT). No unload-station or cabinet photos exist at all. L5 spray and part motion are a local demo placeholder until the Phase 3 signal bus. Comparison renders and objective metrics are in docs/compare/wash-stations/ (blank model_wb_v1, tunnel model_wt_v3). Human visual sign-off (WC-14) received 2026-10-17 - Phase 2b increment-1 fidelity gate cleared.

items.title: overall silhouette and proportions
items.note: Blank station reads as a short stainless conveyor with overhead pipe; tunnel reads as a long low enclosure on a wheeled frame. Relative placement follows the documented sequence (blank wash -> TP/CV wash -> induction), but absolute station positions and lengths are ASSUMED - no dimensioned drawings (NV-011).

items.title: tunnel enclosure shell (roof, drip pan, rear wall, end frames)
items.note: Long stainless enclosure with roof panel, drip pan, rear wall and end aprons/headers framing the conveyor openings, per the contact-sheet view; panel thickness and depths ESTIMATED.

items.title: hinged doors, viewing windows, hinges, handles
items.note: Four front doors built as frame bars plus a glazing pane each (so the interior shows through), with two hinges and a handle per door; window position lowered so the belt and spray zone are visible through the glass. Door count and spacing ESTIMATED.

items.title: overhead piping at the blank wash station
items.note: Overhead pipe run and service drop are photo-observed; the two-post gantry that supports them is ASSUMED because no support structure is visible in the supplied photo.

items.title: lower frame, support legs, wheels/feet
items.note: Tunnel sits on six legs with two cross rails and six caster wheels/feet as observed; blank-station conveyor legs with levelling feet. Leg count and spacing ESTIMATED.

items.title: conveyor alignment and height through both washers
items.note: One straight conveyor line at z = -0.15 with belt top 1.025 m matches the Phase 2a induction feed conveyor exactly (IND-C-BELT), running blank station -> tunnel -> induction with no step. Height is a match to the existing model, not a measurement from the plant.

items.title: yellow spray nozzles (presence, count, orientation)
items.note: Yellow nozzles are visible inside the tunnel through the windows, so presence is photo-supported; 22 nozzle instances (upper row down onto the parts, lower row up) is ESTIMATED - individual nozzles are not countable in the contact-sheet view. No wire-mesh safety guard at these stations; the blank station has a light curtain instead.

items.title: conduits, brackets, fasteners
items.note: Side conduit run with riser and four clamps on the tunnel, plus instanced bolts on the tunnel roof and the blank conveyor frame.

items.title: blank-station safety and identification hardware
items.note: Light-curtain posts with red beam, handheld scanner on a mount post, E-stop on a yellow mount, placards OP_100102 / CV OR #4 / SV-000088 and the A-1 air sign all read from PHOTO-01.

items.title: wash spray and part motion (L5 visualisation)
items.note: Droplet spray, blank motion and light-curtain beam are driven by a local demo toggle placeholder, not the plant program - the typed signal bus replaces this in Phase 3. Parts transiting the tunnel are an inference from conveyor continuity; they are not visible in the photo.

evidence.sourceId: local demo placeholder - no signal bus until Phase 3

items.title: materials, bevels, shadows, surface detail
items.note: Stainless/grey panel palette, painted-yellow nozzles, dark rubber belt and blue-tinted wash water approximated from the photos with the Phase 2a lighting. No bevelled edges, wear or wet-surface modelling yet, and brightness has not been tuned against the washer photos.

items.title: labels, nameplates, warning stickers, panel seams
items.note: Placard strings OP_100102, CV OR #4 and SV-000088 are legible in PHOTO-01; the tunnel nameplate wording is ASSUMED because it is not legible in the contact-sheet view. Warning stickers and door/mullion seams present.

items.title: comparison renders committed
items.note: Blank wash from the PHOTO-01 pose (model_wb_v1) and TP/CV tunnel from the PHOTO-06 pose (model_wt_v1/v2/v3 iteration) are saved under docs/compare/wash-stations/ as side + overlay PNGs with objective metrics (this folder is not under version control, so 'committed' means written to disk). Final tunnel metrics: luma 125.5 vs photo 118.4, edge density 4.1 vs 7.3, histogram cosine (gray) 0.729 - improved from the v1 baseline (luma 152.7, hist_cos 0.379) by giving the tunnel a dedicated darker stainless shell and re-framing the pose. Blank wash: luma 90.8 vs 114.7, edge density 3.8 vs 13.8, hist_cos 0.717. The edge-density gap is expected - the model does not recreate surrounding plant clutter, aisles or ceiling services. Objective metrics are evidence, not a fidelity score; the warm/cool colour cast noted in Phase 2a persists.

items.title: human visual sign-off of comparison renders
items.note: Human review of model_wb_v1_side.png against PHOTO-01 and model_wt_v3_side.png against PHOTO-06 completed and accepted ("accept") on 2026-10-17. Phase 2b increment-1 fidelity gate cleared for WASH-BLANK and WASH-TPCV. The executing model has no image input, so this sign-off is external evidence, not self-assessment.
